series.title: India men: top scorers, past and current players (FIFA match records since 1993)
series.description: The ten India men players with the most goals in international matches FIFA has line-up records for since 1993, marked as past or current players.
series.publisher: FIFA (api.fifa.com v3 calendar and match data; data source of inside.fifa.com)
series.notes: Counted from the line-ups and goal events of 100 of the 103 completed India men matches in FIFA's feed (1993 onwards); a player counts as an appearance if he or she started or came on as a substitute. Own goals and shoot-out penalties are excluded. 'Current' means the player featured in a FIFA-listed match in the last 2 years (since 2024-11-01); everyone else is 'past'. Goal events matched the final score in 91 of those matches. These are totals within FIFA's coverage, not official career caps, so players who also played earlier or in unlisted matches have higher career figures.
